components.name: ExtLink
components.description: Anchor that opens URLs via the extension host's `openExternal` handler instead of relying on `target="_blank"`. VS Code webviews drop anchor clicks inconsistently — especially when the anchor is nested inside a button — so every external link in the webview must route through `vscode.env.openExternal` via postMessage. Drop-in replacement for `<a ... target="_blank">`. Extra props (className, style, onMouseDown, etc.) pass through. The `onClick` prop, if supplied, runs BEFORE the postMessage and can call `e.preventDefault()` to cancel.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: Command palette opened via ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Fuzzy-filters tasks, active agent terminals, and built-in actions in a single list. Arrow keys navigate; Enter fires; Esc closes. Design notes: - We keep this dumb: callers pass in the pool of tasks and the list of active-terminal IDs+labels. We don't reach into stores. - Selection is by index (not id) so duplicate labels don't confuse nav. - Each result commits via an `onRun` callback — either a direct fn the caller wired, or a `window.dispatchEvent(CMD_PALETTE_EVENTS.X)` for cross-component handoffs (UnifiedAgentsPane listens for task detail).

components.name: FleetProjectsSection
components.description: Fleet — Projects, relocated into the Settings (Panel) surface after the Fleet view's left rail was removed (PHNX-3594). The rail was the ONLY way to reach the managed-Projects pane, so removing it left `center === 'projects'` unreachable — nothing calls `setCenter('projects')` anymore, so the pane was orphaned dead code in UnifiedAgentsPane. This restores it (PHNX-3592). Devices are NOT rendered here — PanelTab already owns a Devices section fed by its `devices` prop; this section is Projects only, to avoid a second surface. Self-contained for data exactly like PanelTab's LinearApiKeyCard / WatchdogPlaybookCard: it owns its own postMessage fetches + a single window 'message' listener, and threads nothing through App or PanelTab props. The extension backend answers fetchManagedProjects / fetchLinearProjects regardless of which surface asked. Reuses the mission-control ProjectsPane verbatim (add / remove / link a Linear project). rollups is empty here — Settings has no live agent feed to summarize — and onClose is omitted, so the pane drops its "back to agents" affordance (there is no detail column to return from in Settings).

props.name: devices

components.name: ProjectRulesSection
components.description: Project Rules: an ordered list of cwd->project mappings that control how the Fleet groups agent cards. The first rule whose pattern matches a session's cwd wins; a pattern is a glob (** spans directories, * does not) or a plain path prefix. Persisted in AgentSettings.projectRules via onSaveSettings.
